title: Calibrating your confidence requires thinking of all the ways you could be wrong
abstract: arXiv:2611.08997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A primary limitation of modern deep learning is the miscalibration of model confidence; traditional architectures fundamentally lack a mechanism to quantify their own uncertainty. Larger models and larger datasets mitigate this issue, but they do not resolve the underlying structural deficiency. Bayesian methods offer a principled uncertainty-aware learning framework through stochastic parameters. Yet, despite the established benefits, the inherent computational overhead often compromises either scalability or quality. This trade-off currently prevents the widespread adoption of Bayesian methods.   This Thesis bridges the gap between high-quality and low-complexity by introducing a novel distribution on parameter space: a degenerate Gaussian whose covariance is a projection matrix aligned with the null space of the Fisher information matrix. translated_title: 校准你的置信度需要考虑到所有你可能出错的方式
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习的一个主要局限是模型置信度的校准失准；传统架构从根本上缺乏量化自身不确定性的机制。更大的模型和更大的数据集可以缓解这一问题，但无法解决其根本的结构性缺陷。贝叶斯方法通过随机参数提供了一个有原则的不确定性感知学习框架。然而，尽管其优势已得到证实，其固有的计算开销往往会使可扩展性或质量受到损害。这种权衡目前阻碍了贝叶斯方法的广泛应用。本论文通过在参数空间引入一种新颖的分布来弥合高质量与低复杂度之间的差距：一种退化高斯分布，其协方差是一个与Fisher信息矩阵零空间对齐的投影矩阵。我们通过两种数值高效的算法展示了这种贝叶斯后验的可扩展性。
tldr: 本论文提出一种协方差与Fisher信息矩阵零空间对齐的退化高斯分布，在保持贝叶斯不确定性量化质量的同时大幅降低计算开销，实现了高质量且可扩展的贝叶斯深度学习。
en_tdlr: This thesis introduces a novel degenerate Gaussian distribution whose covariance is a projection matrix aligned with the null space of the Fisher information matrix, enabling high-quality and scalable Bayesian uncertainty quantification in deep learning with low computational complexity.
